command.seedAdd: add a scion to the seed
command.seedRemove: remove a scion from the seed
command.seedReplace: replace the origin of a scion
command.seedLock: lock, verify or restore the seed
command.fileAdd: create a file in the scion
command.fileRemove: remove the file from its scion
command.fileMove: move the file within its scion
command.dirAdd: create a directory in the scion
command.dirRemove: remove the directory from the scion
description: Lepton development environment: lepton tool commands, automatic regraft and clangd restart in VSCodium (ENV-12).
config.path: `lepton` executable. Empty: `~/.local/bin/lepton` (pipx installation) if it exists, otherwise `lepton` from the `PATH`.
config.autoGraft.enabled: Regraft automatically when files are created or deleted under `scion/` of a grafted clone (editor, terminal, git): `lepton graft --path …`.
config.autoGraft.delay: Delay (ms) after the last file event before the automatic regraft; events are grouped.
config.redirectTrunkCreations: Move a regular file created in the trunk to the clone of its owner scion (`lepton file add --adopt`); the trunk keeps a link.
config.restartClangd: Restart clangd when the content of the `compile_commands.json` given by `--compile-commands-dir` (setting `clangd.arguments`) changes.
